annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Council Directives 90/385/EEC and 93/42/EEC and Directive 98/8/EC as regards the review of the medical device directives
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Directive amending Directives 90/385/EEC, 93/42/EEC and 98/8/EC as regards the review of the medical device directives
annotation.summary_en: 2005 European Commission proposal to amend the EU medical device directives (93/42/EEC, 90/385/EEC) and the biocides directive. It clarifies conformity assessment, clinical evaluation, post-market surveillance, notified body duties, transparency and software validation. It has no AI or robotics content beyond software as a medical device.
key_provisions_or_claims: Notified bodies must assess design documentation for class IIa and IIb devices on a representative basis
Clinical data is required for all devices, with a European databank for clinical investigations
Stand-alone software can qualify as a medical device and must be validated to the state of the art
Manufacturers outside the Community must designate an authorised representative
Confidentiality is relaxed: registration, vigilance and certificate data are made public
